title: Xavier Worthy: Lessons learned rehabbing my shoulder might have been the best thing for me

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Xavier Worthy: Lessons learned rehabbing my shoulder might have been the best thing for me
sources.description: Xavier Worthy ran the fastest 40-yard dash in Scouting Combine history before the Chiefs took him in the first round of the 2024 NFL draft, so when asked about competing with the Chiefs' other wide receivers on the practice field, Worthy said he knows he'll always stand out.
